name: Token Efficiency Optimizer
tagline: Spots the runs where more spend cannot change the outcome
description: Watches for runs that have passed the point where extra burn could alter the outcome, explains why it thinks so, and proposes the trim. Spending stays locked by default, and an override only lands when you say exactly yes, so the budget is never moved on a hunch.
author: EricBuess
notes: Native Grok Bot share. Third-party bot; not from xAI.
